upserve.title: UpServe
upserve.tagline: Agents that know your work, doing it for you
upserve.description:
An ontology-driven agent platform.
Repetitive office work — quote processing, document review, email handling, ERP data cleanup — is handled by agents that understand how your business is structured.

features.title: Grounded in an ontology
features.description: UpServe first defines the concepts and relationships your work runs on — quotes, accounts, documents. Agents act with that context, so the results hold up.

features.title: Approval before action
features.description: Hard-to-undo actions like payments or public posting always wait for your approval.

features.title: Autonomous scheduling
features.description: A plain instruction creates a recurring schedule, and results arrive as push notifications.

features.title: Works with your tools
features.description: Connects to 18+ tools including Ecount ERP, Slack, and GitHub.

features.title: Runs in the cloud
features.description: Operates in an isolated cloud sandbox — manage it from a browser or the app, no hardware required.

features.title: Start free
features.description: Start right away with no card required, then scale with the plan that fits.

Services.availableOn: Available on Web, iOS, and Android

Think.title: Think
Think.subtitle: Understands Your Work
Think.description:
UpServe models your work as an ontology.
The concepts and relationships your work runs on — quotes, accounts, documents — become structure, so agents decide with context.

Build.title: Build
Build.subtitle: Works Inside Your Tools
Build.description:
Agents in UpServe work directly in the tools you already use.
They connect to 18+ tools including Ecount ERP, Slack, and GitHub, and run in an isolated cloud sandbox.

Innovate.title: Innovate
Innovate.subtitle: Runs on Its Own
Innovate.description:
Once you hand work to UpServe, it keeps running.
Agents execute on schedule, report results by push notification, and can be managed from the web or the iOS and Android apps.
